scope: Provider-neutral one/five-minute stock bars and Fugle Taiwan intraday adapter
behavior: One-minute and five-minute bars preserve exact decimal text, actual timestamp, volume and fetch time
Fugle API keys come from a caller-supplied source, are not persisted by the package and are sent only to the pinned HTTPS host
The adapter distinguishes authorization failure, missing data and throttling
Wrong market, symbol or interval, malformed OHLC or volume, invalid credentials, duplicate/future timestamps and oversized responses fail closed
The latest actual timestamp is selected without trusting provider response order
One-minute observations older than two minutes and five-minute observations older than six minutes are marked stale
Concurrent identical lookups share one in-flight request
Fugle registers as an authorized intraday provider and routes through the provider-neutral registry
